name: DS Cluster S31: FRED Loading Patterns
description: Tests: economic_indicators(series_id) with ffill pattern, common_indicators enum, RealGDP trap (GDPC1 levels vs A191RL1Q225SBEA growth rate). Always ffill after loading.
source:
# =============================================================================
# DS CLUSTER S31: FRED Loading Patterns
# =============================================================================
# S31 rules:
#   economic_indicators(series_id='X') for any of 840K+ FRED series.
#   Returns: .result — always ffill() after loading.
#   RealGDP TRAP: GDPC1 is chain-weighted LEVELS (cannot compute growth).
#   For GDP growth: series_id='A191RL1Q225SBEA'

src = study_assets()
close = src.c

# === ARBITRARY FRED SERIES (by ID) ===
payems_src = economic_indicators(series_id="PAYEMS")()
nfp = ffill(payems_src.result)

# === CURATED ENUM ===
cpi_src = common_indicators(category=MacroEconomicsIndicator.CPI)()
cpi = ffill(cpi_src.result)

fed_funds_src = common_indicators(category=MacroEconomicsIndicator.FedFunds)()
fed_funds = ffill(fed_funds_src.result)

# === GDP TRAP: levels vs growth rate ===
# WRONG: GDPC1 is chain-weighted levels — cannot compute growth rates
gdp_levels_src = economic_indicators(series_id="GDPC1")()
gdp_levels = ffill(gdp_levels_src.result)

# CORRECT: A191RL1Q225SBEA is actual percent change
gdp_growth_src = economic_indicators(series_id="A191RL1Q225SBEA")()
gdp_growth = ffill(gdp_growth_src.result)

# === YIELD CURVE SPREAD ===
y10_src = common_indicators(category=MacroEconomicsIndicator.Treasury10Y)()
y2_src = common_indicators(category=MacroEconomicsIndicator.Treasury2Y)()
spread_10y2y = ffill(y10_src.result) - ffill(y2_src.result)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title='Non-Farm Payrolls (PAYEMS)',
    category='FRED Loading',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='NFP', color=Color.Blue)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=nfp)

xy_lines(
    title='CPI vs Fed Funds',
    category='FRED Loading',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='CPI', color=Color.Orange),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Fed Funds', color=Color.Blue)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(cpi, fed_funds))

xy_lines(
    title='GDP: Levels (WRONG) vs Growth Rate (CORRECT)',
    category='GDP Trap',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='GDPC1 Levels', color=Color.Red),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='GDP Growth %', color=Color.Green)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(gdp_levels, gdp_growth))

xy_lines(
    title='Yield Curve 10Y-2Y Spread',
    category='FRED Loading',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='10Y-2Y', color=Color.Cyan)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Zero')])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=spread_10y2y)
